# 2.38 Installable, offline tracker: lane notes

## Plan of the whole step (three parts)

- **Part 1, the device holds the game (builder 1).** (a) "Your games" lists every game this device holds plays for that the server lacks, however old, with Dismiss that asks first: `queue-storage.ts` (`leagueId`, `listAll`, `forget`), `held-games.ts`, `held-games-panel.tsx`, `my-games-page.tsx`, `tracker.held.*` messages; tests in `held-games.test.ts` and the queue storage contract. (b) The controller starts from the state, rosters and scoring session kept on the device when the server does not answer, and settles when it does (M5; T-248, T-253): `opened-game-storage.ts` (+ memory and IndexedDB) keeps the session id, cleared with the game; `open-tracker-game.ts`, `tracker-controller.ts`; tests beside each. (c) L9: the tracker's download slimmed, measured before and after.
- **Part 2, installable and opens with no signal (builder 2).** The web app manifest and icons (`apps/web/public`, the tracker's page head), a service worker that stores only the tracker's pages and code (T-115) and replaces them only when no game is open on the device (T-127, T-158); its pure rules (what is stored, when to update) in a module with unit tests; `scripts/check-web-shell.mjs` rows if a route is added.
- **Part 3, proven in a browser (builder 3).** `tests/browser/tracker-offline-test.mjs`: load the tracker, go offline before the reload, reload, keep scoring; taps accepted when the network returns if nobody took the game, listed not saved if somebody did; signing out clears the kept games; a new release waits until the open game is closed; pictures at phone and tablet width; the scoring-screen checklist lines of `docs/build/audits/live-scoring.md` answered; the area lead's review.

## Part 6

- (a) Seen in my first run. Order: offline reload, scoring from the kept session; network back: the queue sends under it, the release had ended it, refused; the halt's renewal says ended, turns read-only, lists the taps, while opening's new session for this device arrives. Fix: under the kept session until opening answers, a refusal or renewal decides nothing (`keptSession`, `settleByOpening` in tracker-controller.ts); opening settles (`hold`). Test: "…though a send under the ended one was refused first" (fails without the guard alone, checked).
- (c) Order: tap saved, the test reloads before the load that follows it is kept (23 ms in that run); the scoring was kept only on loads, so neither the kept state nor `onTop` had the tap: 0-0, and the next opening saw a command not its own ("taken", the other face of (a)). Fix: scoring kept with every tap; a kept tap the kept state already has is not counted twice. Test: "keeps each tap on the device at once…" (fails without, checked).
- (d) Not seen in my runs; order from the code: the reloaded page asks the worker to keep its page and files, fetches under way, signing out deletes the caches, then the copy lands. Fix: `trackerWorkerForgetMessage`: the worker writes one copy at a time, keeps nothing once told, deletes its caches after the copy under way and answers; sign-out asks each worker first (1 s cap for an older worker). Test in tracker-worker-script.test.ts.
- (b) Not a product fault: Chromium can send the leaving page's keepalive release though the context is offline (a real phone with no signal sends nothing). The test now asks the server: held-by-you means the tablet holds the game by opening it, else it takes over.
- Done: debug lines of 091802b removed. T6 (T-253, T-319 lines) say both rules. tracker-offline: 38 runs, 38 passed (1 with build, then 5 and 20 in a row, then 12 four at a time), all after the fixes. Checks: check, typecheck, vitest tracker 47 files 669, prettier.
- Distrust: (d) and (b) were not reproduced here; their fixes rest on the order read from the code. NOT run: the other browser tests, the whole chain.

## Review

- Medium (T-321) `tracker-worker-rules.ts:174` with `:164`: a kept page is shown whenever the network gives no word (no signal, 3 s, a 404 or 5xx), and signing in happens outside the worker's reach, so "signing in needs the network" does not protect: person B signs in on the league's home without A signing out, later opens the home-screen icon with no signal and sees A's kept page (A's email, A's game); B's taps queue as A's, and if A's session had ended `hold`/`carryOnTaps` (`tracker-controller.ts:1096`) sends A's waiting taps under B's new session, recorded as B. Fix: every signed-in page writes its account to IndexedDB; worker and controller refuse another account's kept page and kept scoring even offline.
- Medium (T-322) `tracker-worker-rules.ts:103` with the 14-day keep (`opened-game-storage.ts:89`): a game opened here but never final here (looked at ahead, or finished on another device) holds every release back up to 14 days; once the server refuses that old version (T-127 promises one release back), "update needed"'s Reload gets the same kept old page (game open: kept first, `tracker-worker-script.ts:198`) and the waiting worker never takes over: the scorer is stuck, plays unsendable, until signing out. Fix: a version refusal lets the page bypass the kept copy and tell the worker to update.
- Medium (part 6) `tracker-controller.ts:762` with `:807`: the kept scoring is never cleared when the device loses the game (`stopScoring` nulls the session, so `keepScoringNow` writes nothing); a reload with no signal after a takeover returns to the scoring screen under the taken session, its score counting taps already listed "not saved" (twice for one entered again), the new taps listed not saved later. No test. Fix: clear it on loss; `startFromDevice` drops kept taps the queue holds as not saved or refused.
- Low `tracker-controller.ts:1028`: `recent` keeps 300 ids (`packages/sports` live.ts:208); after more than 300 commands offline under an ended session the taps are listed not saved though nobody else scored.
- Low `tracker-controller.ts:1146`: scoring started from the device whose opening is answered 401 (sign-in expired while away) turns read-only instead of M4's keep scoring with a sign-in link; taps kept, but no tapping mid-game until signed in.
- Low `sign-out-form.tsx:13`: the whole clearing gets 1.5 s, the worker alone 1 s; on a slow phone sign-out can go before the kept page is deleted (online the account mark protects; offline see the first line); an older worker can land a copy after the deletion (fault d, not reproduced).
- Low `queue-storage.ts:182`: plays stored before this release (no `accountId`) are listed and sendable for whoever signs in, so sent as that person; once, on devices upgraded with plays waiting.
- Low `tracker-worker-registration.ts:46`: a waiting worker told to update reads "no game open" before the opening page has saved its game, takes over and deletes the earlier release's files while an old page opens; at worst a lazy chunk fails and the page needs a reload; the queue is safe.
- Low `decisions-pending/T-319.md:7` still says a release waits while the store holds any game; T-322 and T6 say otherwise: correct the row (T-185).
- Checked, no finding: fault (b) judged right (the release is sent only with nothing waiting, `tracker-controller.ts:1846`, so a weak-signal phone does the same and part 6's guard covers it); the step still asserts both taps listed and the score unchanged, though in those runs another device opens a free game rather than taking over. Taps deduplicated by id and by the kept state; the tests check the server's score; a refusal under the kept session settles by opening; held by another on opening lists them; the server takes a session only from its own account (`scoring-session.ts:223`). Code rules: no league named, words in messages, no SQL, strict types, `apps/live-stats` and `packages/sports` untouched.
- Not checked by the reviewer: nothing was run (no unit or browser test); Safari or a real installed phone; a protocol version bump with a game kept.
